## What this changes

## Why

<!-- If this is about a field: what real job post revealed the problem?
     A concrete example is worth more than an argument. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Wording, translation or example (patch)
- [ ] A new field, or a new option on an existing field (minor)
- [ ] A field removed, renamed, or changed in meaning (major)
- [ ] Site, tooling or documentation only

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] If I changed `assets/examples.js`, I ran `npm run examples` and committed the result
- [ ] If I added an i18n key, I added it to **every** language
- [ ] If this changes the template, I updated `CHANGELOG.md` and bumped the version in
      `assets/version.js` and `package.json` to match
